mathematics.title: Calculus: Early Transcendentals
mathematics.description: Success in your calculus course starts here! James Stewart's CALCULUS: EARLY TRANSCENDENTALS texts are world-wide best-sellers for a reason: they are clear, accurate, and filled with relevant, real-world examples.

mathematics.title: Linear Algebra and Its Applications
mathematics.description: Linear Algebra and Its Applications offers a modern elementary introduction with broad, relevant applications. This text makes abstract concepts more accessible by introducing them early in a familiar, concrete setting.

mathematics.title: Introduction to Probability
mathematics.description: An intuitive, yet precise introduction to probability theory, stochastic processes, statistical inference, and probabilistic models used in science, engineering, economics, and related fields.

mathematics.title: Discrete Mathematics and Its Applications
mathematics.description: This renowned best-selling text gives a focused introduction to discrete mathematics and demonstrates the relevance and practicality of discrete mathematics to a wide variety of real-world applications.

mathematics.title: Abstract Algebra
mathematics.description: This widely acclaimed introduction to abstract algebra helps students experience the power and beauty that develops from the rich interplay between different areas of mathematics.

mathematics.title: Real Analysis
mathematics.description: This classic text is the standard reference for real analysis. It covers basic topology, sequences and series, continuity, differentiation, integration, and more with clear, complete proofs.

programming.title: Clean Code
programming.description: Even bad code can function. But if code isn't clean, it can bring a development organization to its knees. This revolutionary paradigm will instill within you the values of a software craftsman.

programming.title: Introduction to Algorithms
programming.description: Introduction to Algorithms uniquely combines rigor and comprehensiveness. The book covers a broad range of algorithms in depth, yet makes their design and analysis accessible to all levels of readers.

programming.title: Design Patterns: Elements of Reusable Object-Oriented Software
programming.description: A modern classic in object-oriented development, offering timeless and elegant solutions to common problems in software design. Learn how patterns fit into the software development process.

programming.title: The Pragmatic Programmer: Your Journey to Mastery
programming.description: One of those rare tech books you'll read, re-read, and read again. These lessons have helped a generation of programmers examine the very essence of software development.

programming.title: JavaScript: The Good Parts
programming.description: This authoritative book scrapes away bad features to reveal a subset of JavaScript that's more reliable, readable, and maintainable than the language as a whole.

programming.title: Python Crash Course
programming.description: The world's best-selling guide to the Python programming language. This fast-paced introduction will have you writing programs, solving problems, and making things that work in no time.

physics.title: University Physics with Modern Physics
physics.description: University Physics continues to set the benchmark for clarity and rigor combined with effective teaching and research-based innovation. Known for its uniquely broad, deep, and thoughtful set of worked examples.

physics.title: Classical Mechanics
physics.description: John Taylor brings clarity and insight to Classical Mechanics. This text covers standard topics in intermediate mechanics and explores advanced topics like chaos, providing strong foundation for advanced work.

physics.title: Introduction to Quantum Mechanics
physics.description: An accessible introduction to quantum mechanics with a clear, friendly style. Griffiths is a famously effective teacher and his book contains exercises that help readers develop their understanding.

physics.title: Introduction to Electrodynamics
physics.description: A rigorous, yet clear and accessible treatment of electromagnetic theory. The book's clear and concise style makes it ideal for both classroom teaching and self-study.

physics.title: Thermodynamics and Statistical Mechanics
physics.description: A clear and concise introduction to thermodynamics and statistical mechanics with visualization throughout to enhance the presentation of physical concepts.

physics.title: Optics
physics.description: Accurate, authoritative and comprehensive. The market leader for over a decade, this book provides a balance of theory and instrumentation with an accessible writing style.

engineering.title: Engineering Mechanics: Statics
engineering.description: Known for its accuracy, clarity, and dependability. This text has provided a solid foundation of mechanics principles for more than 60 years with extensive problem-solving support.

engineering.title: Fundamentals of Electric Circuits
engineering.description: Presents circuit analysis in a manner that is clearer, more interesting, and easier to understand. Features a six-step problem solving methodology applied consistently throughout.

engineering.title: Materials Science and Engineering
engineering.description: Building on seven best-selling editions, this text takes an integrated approach covering metals, ceramics, polymeric materials, composites, and advanced materials with trademark clarity.

engineering.title: Fluid Mechanics
engineering.description: Offers a clear and comprehensive presentation demonstrating the progression from physical concepts to engineering applications. Helps students see the practical importance of fluid mechanics.

engineering.title: Thermodynamics: An Engineering Approach
engineering.description: Covers basic principles of thermodynamics while presenting real-world engineering examples. Helps students develop an intuitive understanding by emphasizing physics and physical arguments.

engineering.title: Control Systems Engineering
engineering.description: Highly regarded for its accessibility and focus on practical applications. Offers a comprehensive introduction to the analysis and design of feedback control systems that support modern technology.

biology.title: Campbell Biology
biology.description: The best-selling biology textbook in the world. More than 6 million students have learned biology with CAMPBELL BIOLOGY. Maintains clear, accessible writing and superior pedagogy.

biology.title: Molecular Biology of the Cell
biology.description: The classic in-depth text reference in cell biology. Written in clear language and beautifully illustrated, the book provides a clear sense of the excitement of modern biology.

biology.title: Lehninger Principles of Biochemistry
biology.description: The best-selling text for introductory biochemistry. Brings clarity and coherence to an often unwieldy discipline with clear writing and careful explanations of difficult concepts.

biology.title: Genetics: A Conceptual Approach
biology.description: Ben Pierce brings a master teacher's experiences to clarify this complex subject by focusing on the big picture of genetics concepts and how those concepts connect to one another.

biology.title: Ecology: Concepts and Applications
biology.description: Places great emphasis on helping students grasp the main concepts of ecology while keeping the presentation more applied than theoretical with an evolutionary perspective throughout.

biology.title: Human Anatomy & Physiology
biology.description: The most accessible, comprehensive, and visually stunning anatomy & physiology textbook on the market. Explains concepts and processes in a meaningful and memorable way.
